system.name: Prism
system.one_liner: a GPU-disaggregated serving system for deep learning recommendation models that splits inference into CPU-intensive and GPU-efficient subgraphs across disaggregated nodes

components.name: RTP Framework
components.role: top layer that turns a recommendation model's compute graph into disaggregated CPU/GPU subgraphs

components.name: Graph Optimizer(s)
components.role: existing graph-level optimizations applied to the computational graph before partitioning

components.name: Resource-Aware Graph Partitioner
components.role: divides the monolithic model into a CPU-intensive and a GPU-efficient subgraph

components.name: Computational Graph
components.role: input compute graph of the recommendation model

components.name: Embedding Tables
components.role: input embedding tables associated with the model

components.name: Configs
components.role: input configuration parameters, e.g. enabling/disabling custom optimizers

components.name: Cluster Orchestration
components.role: middle layer that places and allocates resources for the partitioned subgraphs across the cluster

components.name: Topology-Aware Resource Manager
components.role: packages the two subgraphs into containerized instances and places them onto nodes considering network and node topology

components.name: Inter-Node Scheduling
components.role: selects which nodes host the CN and HN instances

components.name: CN Instance
components.role: containerized instance running the CPU-intensive subgraph

components.name: HN Instance
components.role: containerized instance running the GPU-efficient subgraph

components.name: Intra-Node Allocation
components.role: allocates CPU, GPU, and RNIC resources within a selected node

components.name: CPU
components.role: allocatable compute resource within a node

components.name: GPU
components.role: allocatable accelerator resource within a node

components.name: RNIC
components.role: allocatable network-interface resource within a node

components.name: RPC & Networking
components.role: bottom layer that connects CN and HN instances and schedules their requests to meet latency SLOs

components.name: Incast Flow Control
components.role: controls incast congestion among concurrent requests to the same node

components.name: SLO-Aware Comm. Scheduling
components.role: schedules requests to meet per-request latency SLOs

components.name: TCP/IP
components.role: existing transport protocol available for CN-HN connections

components.name: RDMA
components.role: existing transport protocol used to establish CN-HN connections

content.key_idea: Prism layers a resource-aware graph partitioner, a topology-aware resource manager, and SLO-aware communication scheduling/incast control on top of standard containers and TCP/RDMA transport to disaggregate recommendation-model serving.

evidence: Figure 7 provides an overview of Prism.
It divides a monolithic recommendation model into two subgraphs
the communication scheduler establishes RDMA connections and performs incast control

summary: Figure 7 gives Prism's overall architecture as three stacked layers, with the paper's key novel components highlighted in purple. The RTP Framework takes a computational graph, embedding tables, and configs, applies generic Graph Optimizer(s), and uses a Resource-Aware Graph Partitioner to split the model into a CPU-intensive and a GPU-efficient subgraph. Cluster Orchestration's Topology-Aware Resource Manager packages these into containerized CN and HN Instances, using Inter-Node Scheduling to place them and Intra-Node Allocation to assign CPU, GPU, and RNIC resources, considering network and node topology. RPC & Networking then connects the placed instances over TCP/IP or RDMA, with Incast Flow Control and SLO-Aware Comm. Scheduling managing congestion and per-request latency SLOs. The layered layout with purple emphasis lets a reader see which four components are Prism's contribution versus which building blocks are reused.
